# cloudsmith_package (Data Source)

The `cloudsmith_package` data source allows you to list details and download a specific package from a given repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

provider "cloudsmith" {
  api_key = "my-api-key"
}

resource "cloudsmith_repository" "test" {
  name      = "terraform-acc-test-package"
  namespace = "<your-namespace>"
}

data "cloudsmith_package_list" "test" {
  repository = cloudsmith_repository.test.name
  namespace  = cloudsmith_repository.test.namespace
  filters = [
    "name:dummy-package",
    "version:1.0.48",
  ]
}

data "cloudsmith_package" "test" {
  repository   = cloudsmith_repository.test.name
  namespace    = cloudsmith_repository.test.namespace
  identifier   = data.cloudsmith_package_list.test.packages[0].slug_perm
  download     = true
  download_dir = "/path/to/your/directory"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) The identifier for this repository.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the package
- `repository` (String) The repository of the package

### Optional

- `download` (Boolean) If set to true, download the package
- `download_dir` (String) The directory where the file will be downloaded if download is set to true
- `ignore_checksums` (Boolean) Ignore checksums for the package

### Read-Only

- `cdn_url` (String) The URL of the package to download.
- `checksum_md5` (String) MD5 hash of the package
- `checksum_sha1` (String) SHA1 hash of the package
- `checksum_sha256` (String) SHA256 hash of the package
- `checksum_sha512` (String) SHA512 hash of the package
- `format` (String) The format of the package
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_sync_awaiting` (Boolean) Is the package awaiting synchronization
- `is_sync_completed` (Boolean) Has the package synchronization completed
- `is_sync_failed` (Boolean) Has the package synchronization failed
- `is_sync_in_flight` (Boolean) Is the package synchronization currently in-flight
- `is_sync_in_progress` (Boolean) Is the package synchronization currently in-progress
- `name` (String) A descriptive name for the package.
- `output_directory` (String) The directory where the file is downloaded
- `output_path` (String) The location of the package
- `slug` (String) The slug identifies the package in URIs.
- `slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm immutably identifies the package. It will never change once a package has been created.
- `version` (String) The version of the package
